svg.aria-label: Event flow of the Keystone operator
svg.title: Event flow of the Keystone operator
svg.text: gated on transition into ExtraConfigHealthy=False, Reason=OwnedKeysOverridden
A filled chip is a Warning event, an outline chip a Normal event. A line with two chips emits one or the other.
Every reason is described in the Event Reasons Reference of the page.
